title: Small Ships
description: Vanilla friendly Ships for Minecraft. Now with cannons!
body: # Small Ships *Medieval-inspired ships for exploration, trade, and naval battles!* --- ## Play with Friends! Want to play together with your friends? Check out **DatHost** for the best performance and easy setup! ### How to Get Started 1. Go to [**DatHost using my Link**](https://dathost.net/r/talhanation/minecraft-server-hosting) 2. Register your account. 3. Once registered, choose the plan that fits your needs 4. The **30% discount will be applied automatically** at checkout. **Important:** The discount only works if you order your server using this [** my Link**](https://dathost.net/r/talhanation/minecraft-server-hosting) ! [![DatHost](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6ec0353-37bd-4f09-a427-694da9f8c500)](https://dathost.net/minecraft-server-hosting?ref=talhanation) --- ## Showcase ## My Other Mods ### [**Villager Recruits**](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-recruits): Command your own **Villager Army** into war! Now with **Diplomacy and Factions**! --- ### [**Villager Workers**](https://modrinth.com/mod/villager-workers): Hire Villagers and let them **work for you**! --- ### [![siegeweapons-icon](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0e78b9e3-0d34-47a4-802e-adf55eec21e3)](https://modrinth.com/mod/siegeweapons) [**Siege Weapons**](https://modrinth.com/mod/siegeweapons): Prepare for war. Build your siege weapon. **Dominate the battlefield!** --- ## Explanation - Craft a Dockyard and place it next to water. - Right-click the Dockyard, choose a ship and a wood type and press "Build ship". The materials are taken from your inventory. - The finished ship is placed in the water near the Dockyard. The water has to be wide and deep enough. - Right-click the ship to board. The first player gets the helm. Other players get the free seat closest to where they clicked. - Press **R** to open/close the sail. - **W / S** to increase or decrease the sail. - **A / D** to steer. - The keys for your seat are shown on screen when you board. - Ships can only be built at the Dockyard. There are no crafting recipes for ships. - Ships can be lost. A sunken ship can not be recovered. --- ## Controls **Helm** | Key | Action | |---|---| | R | Open / close the sail | | W / S | More / less sail (4 steps). With closed sail: move slowly forward / backward | | A / D | Steer | | W | Row (Galley and Drakkar) | | Hold right mouse button | Aim the cannons on the side you are looking at | | Right mouse button + mouse wheel | Change ammo | | Space | Shoot | | E (inventory key) | Open ship inventory | | Mouse wheel | Camera distance in third person | **Gunner** | Key | Action | |---|---| | Hold right mouse button | Aim your cannon | | Right mouse button + mouse wheel | Change ammo | | Space | Shoot your cannon | **Other** - Right-click another spot of the ship with an empty hand to change your seat. - Right-click a cannon to sit at it as gunner. - Crouch + right-click to open the inventory from outside of the ship. - Right-click a mob while sitting in the ship to take it on board. - Right-click a mob on the ship to dismount it. - The sail key can be changed in the options. The other keys use your vanilla key binds. --- ## Dockyard - Materials are taken from your inventory. - Every job takes time. In creative mode it is free and instant. - Nobody can board a ship while the Dockyard works on it. ### Build - Choose the ship and one of the 9 wood types. - Any planks can be used. The wood type only changes the look of the ship. - The Dockyard shows the attributes and the wind profile of the ship before you build it. - Bigger ships need deeper water. The Dockyard tells you if the water is too shallow or if there is not enough room. | Ship | Planks | White Wool | String | Iron | Build time | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | Galley | 96 | 24 | 12 | 18 nuggets | 2:00 min | | Drakkar | 96 | 24 | 12 | 36 nuggets | 2:00 min | | Dhow | 96 | 48 | 48 | none | 2:00 min | | Caravel | 120 | 48 | 24 | 30 nuggets | 2:15 min | | Cog | 192 | 24 | 12 | 48 nuggets | 3:00 min | | Brigg | 240 | 48 | 24 | 8 ingots | 3:30 min | | Galleon | 336 | 72 | 36 | 12 ingots | 4:30 min | ### Modify Works on a ship within 16 blocks of the Dockyard. - Install or remove upgrades. - Mount or remove cannons. - Hang shields on the Drakkar. - Change sail color, mast banner and sail banner. - Rename the ship. - Repair hull and sails. Removed cannons, shields and banners are given back. Removed upgrades give back 30% of the material. --- ## Ships These are the default values. All of them can be changed in the config. | Ship | Hull | Speed | Turning | Slots | Cannons | Seats | Water | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Cog | 400 HP | 27 km/h | 4.0 | 108 | 4 | 11 | cold | | Brigg | 500 HP | 30 km/h | 3.0 | 162 | 6 | 17 | cold | | Galley | 200 HP | 35 km/h | 5.0 | 54 | 2 | 12 | warm | | Drakkar | 200 HP | 28 km/h | 5.0 | 54 | 0 | 15 | cold | | Caravel | 250 HP | 32 km/h | 4.75 | 81 | 4 | 10 | any | | Dhow | 200 HP | 32 km/h | 4.5 | 135 | 4 | 12 | warm | | Galleon | 700 HP | 25 km/h | 1.5 | 216 | 10 | 34 | any | A mounted cannon can take up one seat. ### Cog - Trade ship with one mast (cold water). - Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. - Best with tail wind. ### Brigg - Trade ship with two masts (cold water). - Up to 6 cannons, 3 on each side. - Best with tail wind. ### Galley - Warship with one sail and oars (warm water). - Up to 2 cannons, 1 on each side. - With oars it reaches 85% of its speed in any wind. - Takes no hull damage when it rams another ship. - Best with side wind. ### Drakkar - Viking ship with one sail and oars (cold water). - With oars it reaches 75% of its speed in any wind. - Up to 10 shields, 5 on each side. Each shield reduces the damage to the ship by 3%. - Breaks ice. - Best with tail wind. ### Caravel - Ship with two masts. - Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. - Can sail against the wind. Best with head wind and side wind. - Same speed in every biome. ### Dhow - Trade ship with two masts (warm water). - Up to 4 cannons, 2 on each side. - Cargo does not slow it down. - Best with side wind. ### Galleon - The biggest ship, with three masts. - Up to 10 cannons, 5 on each side. - Cannons do not slow it down. - Same speed in every biome. - Best with tail wind. --- ## Detailed Features ### Wind - The wind changes direction and strength every few minutes. It is stronger in rain and thunder. - White lines on the water show the wind direction while you are on a ship. The banner on the mast shows it too. - Every ship has its own wind profile. The table shows the speed change at full wind strength with full sail. - A ship can not get faster than its max speed. - Oars are not affected by the wind. - The sail closes when nobody is at the helm. | Ship | Head wind | Side wind | Tail wind | |---|---|---|---| | Cog | -70% | +10% | +50% | | Brigg | -75% | +20% | +40% | | Galley | -30% | +40% | 0% | | Drakkar | -70% | +10% | +40% | | Caravel | +10% | +15% | -20% | | Dhow | -40% | +20% | 0% | | Galleon | -100% | -20% | +50% | ### Ship Performance - **Cold-water ships** → 20% faster in cold biomes, 20% slower in warm. - **Warm-water ships** → 20% faster in warm biomes, 20% slower in cold. - Both are 5% slower in biomes that are neither cold nor warm. - Each cannon decreases speed by **2.5%** (not on the Galleon). - Cargo can decrease speed by up to **10%** (not on the Dhow). - Torn sails give 25% less speed. Destroyed sails give no speed. ### Cannons - Cannons are mounted at the Dockyard. Each cannon needs one Ship Cannon item. - Remove a cannon at the Dockyard or in the ship inventory (click and hold). - At the helm you aim and shoot all cannons on the side you are looking at. - A gunner aims and shoots only his own cannon. The helm does not shoot cannons that have a gunner. - While aiming, the camera is on the barrel and a line shows where the shot goes. - Ammo is taken from the ship inventory first, then from the inventory of the shooter. - The HUD shows the available ammo while aiming. - Reloading takes about 4 seconds. - A hit on the mast damages the sails. A hit on the hull damages the hull. - Hits on a ship throw wood debris and sail shreds. - Cannonballs that hit the ground make a small explosion. - Passengers can not damage their own ship. ### Ammo - **Cannon Ball** → normal shot, best against the hull. - **Chained Shot** → 25% less range and damage, heavy damage to sails. - **Grape Shot** → short range, best against the crew. - **Fine-Grain Powder** → used up when shooting, +50% range. ### Ground Cannon - Use the Ship Cannon item on the ground to place it. - Right-click to use it. **W / S** to move, **A / D** to turn. - Hold the right mouse button to aim. Double right-click turns the barrel back to the front. - Shoot with **Space**. Ammo is taken from your inventory. ### Ramming - Ships damage each other when they collide at 20 km/h or more. - More speed means more damage. The smaller ship takes more damage and gets pushed away. - The crew of both ships takes damage too. - Hitting land at high speed damages your own ship. - A sailing ship pushes and damages mobs in its way. ### Sinking - Ships do not repair themselves. - A ship with no hull HP left sinks with a sinking animation. The crew is thrown into the water. - **A sunken ship is lost.** It can not be repaired, boarded or picked up. - The wreck despawns after 15 minutes and drops its cargo and cannons. ### Ship Repairing - Hull: right-click with an iron nugget while you have planks in your inventory. Works up to 66% hull. - Sail patching: right-click with string while you have an iron nugget in your inventory. Works up to 33% sail. - Dockyard: repairs hull and sails completely. Costs 4 planks and 1 iron nugget per 10 hull HP and 1 wool per 5 sail HP. ### Ship Upgrades - **Iron Scantlings** → +100% hull HP. - **Copper Plating** → +20% turning. - **Cotton Sails** → +10% speed. - Upgrades are installed at the Dockyard. Bigger ships need more items: | Ship | Iron Scantlings | Copper Plating | Cotton Sails | |---|---|---|---| | Cog | 4 | 4 | 1 | | Brigg | 12 | 8 | 4 | | Galley | 5 | 4 | 1 | | Drakkar | 5 | 5 | 1 | | Caravel | 5 | 4 | 2 | | Dhow | 3 | 3 | 2 | | Galleon | 16 | 12 | 8 | ### Inventory - Hoppers can put items into the ship inventory and take them out. - The ship inventory shows speed and damage of the ship. - Cannons, banners and shields can be removed in the ship inventory (click and hold). ### Sail Coloring - Right-click with dye to color sails. ### Banners - Right-click with a banner to put it on the mast. Shears remove it. - A banner pattern can be put on the sail at the Dockyard. ### Shields - Right-click the Drakkar with a shield to hang it up. An axe removes it. - Shields with banner patterns are supported. - Epic Knights shields are supported. ### Ship Naming - Use a nametag to name your ship, or rename it at the Dockyard. ### Leashing - Right-click a ship with a lead to pull it. - Right-click a fence to tie the ship to it. - A leashed ship can not sail. ### Other - Decks are walkable. - Mobs can be passengers. NPCs standing on the deck leave onto nearby land when the ship lies still. - All ships break lily pads. - Bubble columns do not affect ships. - Water animals swim away from ships. - Vanilla boats are 75% slower by default. --- ## Crafting **Dockyard** **Ship Cannon** (any log) **Cannon Ball** Gunpowder in the middle, 4 iron nuggets on the sides. Gives 2. **Chained Shot** Chain in the middle, 4 Cannon Balls in the corners. Gives 2. **Grape Shot** Gunpowder in the middle, 8 iron nuggets around it. **Fine-Grain Powder** **Iron Scantlings** **Copper Plating** **Cotton Sails** --- ## Config **Server config** (`smallships-server.toml`, in the `serverconfig` folder of the world). Server values are synced to the clients. - Attributes for each ship: hull HP, speed, turning, acceleration, inventory size, water type. Changes apply to existing ships. - `dockyardBuildableShips`: ships that can be built at the Dockyard. Empty = all ships. - Upgrades: enable, cost, time, refund and strength. - Wind: enable, change interval, minimum strength in rain and thunder. - Cannon damage, block destruction, sail damage, collision damage, shield damage reduction. - Speed modifiers for cargo, cannons and biomes. - `mountBlackList`: entities that can not mount a ship. - `driverEntities`: non-player entities that can take the helm (default: `recruits:captain`). - Vanilla boat speed, despawn time of sunken ships, `updateCheckerEnable`. **Client config** (`smallships-client.toml`, in the `config` folder) - Speed unit: km/h, m/s, knots or mph. - Camera: auto third person, camera centered on the ship, zoom distance. - Wind particles and banner movement. - Creative tab, `updateCheckerEnable`. **Commands** - `/smallships wind` shows the wind direction and strength. - `/smallships wind setDirection <0-360>` sets the wind direction (north = 0, clockwise). Needs OP. - `/smallships wind setStrength <0-1>` sets the wind strength. Needs OP. **Update checker** - Shows a chat message with a download link when a new version is available. --- ## Datapacks and Addons Dockyard recipes can be changed with a datapack. One file per ship: `data//dockyard_recipes/.json`. `build_time` is in ticks. ```json { "build_time": 3600, "ingredients": [ { "tag": "minecraft:planks", "count": 192 }, { "item": "minecraft:white_wool", "count": 24 }, { "item": "minecraft:string", "count": 12 }, { "item": "minecraft:iron_nugget", "count": 48 } ] } ``` Addon mods can add their own ships with the ship registry. Registered ships show up in the Dockyard. ```java ShipRegistry.register(ShipType.builder(new ResourceLocation("myaddon", "longship"), LongshipEntity::summon) .buildTime(110 * 20) .ingredient(ItemTags.PLANKS, 112) .ingredient(Items.WHITE_WOOL, 20) .build()); ``` The Fabric version needs Fabric API. --- ## Modpack Permissions You are allowed to use the Small Ships Mod in any modpack, as long as you link back to this page and don’t make money off of it. ---
